race.description: All Too Hard @ Vinery Stud Hcp (Bm72)
race.comment: SCENIC POINT (3) has led for the judge then battled on well in her two runs this prep but has just peaked late on each occasion. Back trip on her latest effort, a 0.7-lengths second at the Kensington circuit. Twice a winner at 1100m and is sure to take plenty of catching. HELLABELLA (7) improved out of sight last time out at the second run back from a spell, making light of 60.5kgs to salute over today's journey at Hawkesbury. Yet to fire in a couple of third-up runs but she is more furnished now and looks up to this. The interesting runner is Waller's BALLET D'LIGHT (11) who led all the way for an impressive win on debut over this distance at Rosehill a fortnight ago. Goes straight to a BM72 which is ambitious but says a lot about the stable's opinion. ELLIPSIS (2) returned with an eye-catcher over this distance at Rosehill recently. Key runner again despite the big weight. SHADY ROAD (5) is a classy mare who can play a big role despite coming off a 130-day spell.
